entities.summary: The Front for Patriotic Resistance in Ituri is a Bunia-based armed militia and political party primarily active in the south of the Ituri Province of northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. It is a member of the Congo River Alliance. Front for Patriotic Resistance in Ituri is a armed organization in Africa, established in 2002. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
